subject: Vendor onboarding: PO flow, billing cycle alignment & accelerated-pay option
summary: AsterByte requests Net45 terms and an accelerated payment program; Redwood procurement team outlines PO header requirements, intake checklist, and early-pay enrollment path. Agreed next steps: complete vendor form, confirm bank remit, pilot early-pay rate negotiation.
messages:
From: Karen Mills <karen@asterbyte.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: purchasing@asterbyte.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor Onboarding: PO Flow & Payment Terms

Hi Olga,

Thanks for taking this on. We're onboarding Redwood as a preferred ML inference partner and want to align on a few quick items so our procurement team can activate POs:

- Our standard payment lane is Net45 — would Redwood accept Net45 for initial 6 months?
- We also have an accelerated-pay program: 1% discount for payment within 15 days (we can negotiate). Can Redwood support early-pay enrollment?
- Attached is our vendor info packet and W-9 for reference.

Can you confirm what PO header fields your AP team requires (PO#, department code, project code, billing contact), and whether you need invoices uploaded to a portal vs. emailed to ap@redwoodinference.com?

If helpful, Karen and I are available for a 30-min call tomorrow afternoon to walk through the intake form.

Thanks,
Karen Mills
Procurement Lead
AsterByte Inc.
(purchasing@asterbyte.com)

Attachments: asterbyte_vendor_info.pdf (attachment - pdf)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karen Mills <karen@asterbyte.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2028 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor Onboarding: PO Flow & Payment Terms

Hi Karen — great to meet you (virtually). Welcome aboard — excited to partner with AsterByte. Summary / next steps from our side:

1) PO header requirements (minimal set we need on every invoice):
   - PO Number (mandatory)
   - Bill-to: Redwood Inference, AP Team (see ap@redwoodinference.com)
   - Project / GL code (if applicable)
   - Billing contact name + email

2) Accepted invoice delivery methods:
   - Preferred: upload to our vendor portal (we'll send an invite)
   - Alternate: email to ap@redwoodinference.com (PDF invoices)

3) Net terms & early pay options:
   - We can accept Net45 on a 6-month pilot for new strategic vendors; we'll log this on the account and confirm in the onboarding ticket.
   - Early-pay enrollment is supported via our "Accelerated Remit" program. Typical structure: 1% for payment within 15 days OR 0.75% for payment within 10 days (depends on billing cadence).

4) What we need from you now:
   - Completed Vendor Onboarding Checklist (attached)
   - Confirm bank remit & ACH details (for early-pay settlement testing)
   - Preferred billing cadence (monthly consolidated vs. per-invoice)

I've attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx and a PO field mapping CSV for David's team to validate. I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30-min kickoff.

Olga
Supplier Enablement Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx (attachment - spreadsheet); PO_Field_Mapping.csv (attachment - csv)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Karen Mills <karen@asterbyte.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2028 10:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor Onboarding: PO Flow & Payment Terms

Olga / Karen — quick note from AP: we require the PO# to be present in the subject line of the invoice PDF when emailed, and the portal ingestion validates PO and GL code fields. If AsterByte will send consolidated monthly statements instead of per-invoice billing, please confirm so we can adjust the portal parsing rules.

Also: for the early-pay pilot we'll need a sample ACH remittance file and a signed enrollment form (simple two-line agreement). Priya — can you own the DocuSign for the enrollment template?

Thanks,
David
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference

> On Tue, Jul 23, 2028 at 09:45 AM Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> > I've attached our Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx and a PO field mapping CSV for David's team to validate.

From: Karen Mills <karen@asterbyte.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: purchasing@asterbyte.com, david.kim@redwoodinference.com, priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jul 2028 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor Onboarding: PO Flow & Payment Terms

Thanks, Olga — that all looks straightforward. We can do Net45 for the initial six-month term. Regarding early pay: our treasury team is willing to move to a 10-day window at 0.75% if Redwood can accommodate that rate; it helps our cash forecasting.

Action items from AsterByte:
- I'll complete the Vendor Onboarding Checklist and return it by end of day Thursday.
- I'll attach the ACH remit sample and signed early-pay request (see attached PDF).
- Please send the DocuSign enrollment form and portal invite.

If you can send the canonical enrollment DocuSign link, I can get this routed immediately.

Cheers,
Karen
Procurement Lead, AsterByte Inc.

Attachments: AsterByte_EarlyPay_Request.pdf (attachment - pdf)
